name: Врата и ключи
style: DUNGEON GATES: tabs are squat oak dungeon-door slabs with prominent black iron strap hinges and small ring pulls at their ends. Side panels are framed by chunky door jambs with short chain attachments. A conspicuous iron keyhole plate marks selected tab, without replacing its label/icon. Main CTA is a shut wooden gate inset in a low squared stone portal, a large antique key beside 'В путь'. Dry dark oak, dull charcoal iron, brick-red paint. No chains crossing text.
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE fully illustrated 16:9 intoDeDung hub screen. Reference gives layout and scene, NOT the new frame design. Redesign the UI with immediately recognizable DUNGEON ATTRIBUTES built into BUTTON SHAPES, PANEL FRAMES and selection markers. Make these details conspicuous at menu scale, not tiny background props. Keep MATTE WOOD covering most of every button face, diffuse dry shading, restrained grain; no lacquer, glossy bevels, gold trim, jewels or bloom. Use dull iron/stone accents and muted brick red selection; no yellow/gold selected-card border. Clear cream lettering, dark ink on parchment. Preserve four top tabs, resource line, three squad cards left, fortress courtyard with three heroes center, preparation panel right, main action bottom-right. Retain the reference sunset courtyard. Large readable labels, uncluttered interiors, small functional icons. Info rows are flat text, not raised buttons. Exact labels: 'Поход', 'Наёмники', 'Кузнец', 'Колода'; 'Золото 100', 'Эссенция 0'; 'Отряд', 'Воин', 'Щитоносец', 'Лучница', 'Дополнительно'; 'Подготовка', '7 комнат', 'Отряд: 3', 'Колода: 10 карт', 'Готово', 'В путь'. No extra cards/tabs, no collage, no outside captions, no watermark. VARIANT: DUNGEON GATES: tabs are squat oak dungeon-door slabs with prominent black iron strap hinges and small ring pulls at their ends. Side panels are framed by chunky door jambs with short chain attachments. A conspicuous iron keyhole plate marks selected tab, without replacing its label/icon. Main CTA is a shut wooden gate inset in a low squared stone portal, a large antique key beside 'В путь'. Dry dark oak, dull charcoal iron, brick-red paint. No chains crossing text.

reference.usage_description: Use for layout, fortress and squad reference only. Keep exactly three squad cards and three courtyard heroes; follow the variant prompt for matte wooden buttons.
